metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Discovery (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Exploration Envelope for RTT • Regimes • Operators • Measures
metadata.description: Defines the non-authoritative discovery projection for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Discovery is a projection only; authoritative values come from state, alignments, context, log, dashboard, overlay, history, analytics, awareness, profile, navigation, and autonomy.

structural.description: Explore RTT structure, regime boundaries, and operator mappings.
constraints: RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.

measure_based.description: Explore measure states and their implications.

paradox_based.description: Explore typed paradox events and harmonic viability.
constraints: Typed paradox required for RTT7 entry.

consent_based.description: Explore consent gating and AA3 escalation boundaries.
constraints: If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.

substrate_based.description: Explore substrate class and harmonic eligibility.

lineage_based.description: Explore lineage continuity and collapse effects.

consent: If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.
paradox: Typed paradox required for RTT7 entry.

projection_rules: Discovery MUST NOT contradict authoritative session.state.json.
Discovery MUST NOT invent measure values.
Discovery MUST NOT invent paradox types.
Discovery MUST NOT invent substrate classes.
rtt_rules: rtt_node MUST be one of RTT1–RTT12.
RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
regime_rules: Regime MUST be nominal, harmonic, or resolution.
Regime MUST match rtt_node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.
consent_rules: If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.

non_claims: Discovery does not revise RTT v0.9.
Discovery does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Discovery does not replace the human FFT book.
